A $2 Trillion Test

Anthropic, the company behind Claude, has publicly filed its S-1 and is targeting an IPO as early as the week of November 16th. Anthropic is seeking a $2 trillion valuation, more than double its most recent funding round in April of this year. [...] On one hand Anthropic Is largely viewed as the leader in the Artificial Intelligence race. But a $2 trillion dollar valuation paired with the financial metrics reported in the S1 leaves plenty of room for skepticism about how much an investor should pay for extraordinary growth in an intensely iterative environment where a company can go from leader to obsolete in no time flat. The company must ultimately demonstrate that this growth can produce durable profits after considering the [...] The IPO is coming precisely at a time when scrutiny around the AI trade is amping up. As investors begin to move beyond being impressed by what AI can do and toward asking what AI can earn.  Recent reactions to earnings show that more capex is no longer automatically good news.
